description: Maintains synchronized suffix-array intervals while extending an exact pattern at either end using paired forward and reversed-text FM-indexes.

source.title: High Throughput Short Read Alignment via Bi-directional BWT
source.reference: 2009 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine, pp. 31-36, DOI 10.1109/BIBM.2009.42
source.copyright: The paper is copyrighted by IEEE; this package uses the published algorithm description and contains independently written code and fixtures.

side_encoding.0: prepend symbol to the current pattern
side_encoding.1: append symbol to the current pattern

output.meaning: For each operation t, count all possibly overlapping occurrences of the current nonempty pattern in the original text and add t*count, with t one-based.

algorithm_details.profile_scope: Exact bidirectional FM-index extension only. The profile does not implement approximate alignment, mismatch enumeration, suffix-array locating, compressed rank structures, or compressed-space guarantees.
algorithm_details.primary: Build suffix arrays and BWT columns for text plus a unique smallest terminator and for the reversed text plus its terminator. Maintain synchronized half-open suffix-array intervals for P in the forward text and reverse(P) in the reversed text. Prepending c performs ordinary BWT backward extension on the forward interval and partitions that interval by BWT symbols to update the reverse interval; appending c performs the symmetric operations on the reversed index. A bounded scan over a BWT column implements Occ(c,i).
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: Materialize the pattern by prepending/appending each supplied symbol, then compare it directly at every valid text offset, including overlapping occurrences.
algorithm_details.extension_complexity: O(sigma*N) bounded rank-scan work per extension for the fixed alphabet with sigma=5 including the terminator.
algorithm_details.call_complexity: O(N^3 + Q*sigma*N) time with insertion-sorted suffix arrays and O(N) index storage, within the fixed limits.
algorithm_details.tie_rules: Alphabet symbols 1..4 are ordered numerically; terminator 0 is unique and smaller than all text symbols. Suffix-array intervals are half-open. Empty intervals remain empty under every later extension. Every output count includes overlapping occurrences.
